english: Emil looks at the letter.
There is no name on the paper.
target: Auf dem Papier steht kein Name.

english: But five words are written there.
Come to the bridge at ten.
Bring the key with you.
Clara is not calm.
Who is writing this letter?
Emil does not know.
But he finds a red thread.
target: Aber er findet einen roten Faden.

english: The thread lies under the paper.
target: Der Faden liegt unter dem Papier.

english: Emil also sees a trace.
A shoe is wet.
There is mud on the floor.
The man in the fog was here.
target: Der Mann im Nebel war hier.

english: But why?
Emil has an idea.
We are going to the bridge, he says.
target: Wir gehen zur Brücke, sagt er.

english: Clara takes the key with her.
Emil is wearing an old coat.
There is a small watch in his pocket.
target: In seiner Tasche ist eine kleine Uhr.

english: It is ten o’clock.
The bridge is empty.
Then they hear a voice.
The key opens no door, says the voice.
target: Der Schlüssel öffnet keine Tür, sagt die Stimme.

english: It opens a box.
Where is the box? Clara asks.
target: Wo ist die Kiste? fragt Clara.

english: In the courtyard of number seventeen.
A man comes out of the fog.
target: Ein Mann kommt aus dem Nebel.

english: There is a red thread on his coat.
target: An seinem Mantel ist ein roter Faden.

english: Emil smiles.
Now I know the first answer, he says.
target: Jetzt kenne ich die erste Antwort, sagt er.
